A person sits in a cafe, smiling warmly at the camera, captured in a mid-shot

The full-body photo shows her curvaceous figure. She stands confidently in the hallway of a Japanese school, her hands on her hips, facing the camera. She has a soft oval face with flawless fair skin, dark brown almond-shaped eyes with clear pupils, a straight nose with a rounded tip, and M-shaped pink lips that frame a gentle smile. Her eyebrows are naturally dark, and her straight bangs frame her neat bob, which curls inward below her ears. She wears minimal makeup, including pink blush and light eyeshadow. She wears an off-white, sailor-style shirt with a striped bow, paired with a dark pleated miniskirt, white socks, and light blue shoes. The warm interior lighting and background details—such as soft shadows, hanging clothes, plants, and a wall clock—create a calm, everyday atmosphere.
